title: Generate a human-review backlog counter for CODEN AI Factory
description: Improve the CODEN software factory review queue with a small pure Python helper. Given value, a list of job-status strings, return an integer count of entries equal to either 'pending_review' or 'needs_review'. Count duplicates individually. All other statuses must be ignored. Write only def transform(value): using a simple loop, integer counter and membership in a tuple or list. No imports, helpers, network, filesystem, recursion, or external services.
